The '''''Sea Sprite''''' was a [[repulsorlift harvester]] owned by [[Tirgee Benyalle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]]. Benyalle led a group of investors, including [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Uther Kermen]], Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]], [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Talon Karrde|Pandis Hart]], and representatives from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], in a tour of the harvester.
